_meta.why: Names the renderer actually knows. An unknown name renders a blank square instead of failing, so this is extracted rather than hand-written.

corrections.what: Azure shape values were extracted as stencil FILE PATHS ('mscae/ADFS') rather than draw.io shape names ('mxgraph.mscae.cloud.adfs'). Every Azure icon therefore rendered as a blank white square while passing the catalog's own existence check -- the exact failure the catalog exists to prevent, hiding inside the catalog.
corrections.how_verified: Rendered each candidate and measured SVG byte size against a deliberately fake negative control (909b). Resolved shapes return 1.9-3.4 KB. Primitive counting does NOT discriminate here -- these stencils emit no path elements, so the original verifier's metric reported a false negative on every Azure name.
